objective: Discover transformation stories before the rerating becomes obvious.
architecture: Fundamental/corporate catalyst is the first discovery layer.
Capacity expansion is separated from actual commissioning/commercial production, with commissioning weighted more strongly.
Order wins, customer qualification, new products and future-facing products are explicit catalyst families.
Business inflection uses point-in-time positive earnings, debt reduction and credit improvement evidence where available.
Promoter conviction distinguishes genuine promoter buying from low-information transfers/ESOP-like activity.
Persistent abnormal volume, up-volume concentration and accumulation days are explicit accumulation signals.
Strong promoter buying plus abnormal accumulation may independently qualify a candidate even when event text is incomplete.
Technical momentum is a confirmation layer only and receives 10% of the positive score.
Stocks with very large prior 6-12 month rerating receive an explicit already-priced-in penalty; recent commissioning partially relaxes that penalty.
The watchlist is maximum Top-10, not a requirement to force ten weak names.
No outcome-based weight, threshold or keyword tuning is permitted after seeing the first V11 backtest result.
Pledge reduction is a positive ownership-quality signal; new/increased pledge is a risk penalty.
Persistent multi-day abnormal volume is preferred over a single volume spike.
Approvals, PLI/incentives and strategic integrations are supporting catalysts, with lower weights than commissioning/capacity/order wins.

data_policy.events: Point-in-time NSE corporate announcement archive, publication timestamp only.
data_policy.promoter_insider: Point-in-time NSE PIT disclosures; open-market purchases receive the highest transaction-quality weight.
data_policy.shareholding: Latest disclosed promoter holding available as of each scoring date.
data_policy.volume_price: Backward-looking market data only; no future labels in features.
data_policy.technical_control: V10.2 calibrated probability/downside used only after discovery signals are formed.
